top_signals.title: Fed's Collins warns inflation could be 'notably' higher after backing rate hike
top_signals.summary: There is "an increased likelihood" of inflation staying "notably" above the Federal Reserve's 2% target, Boston Federal Reserve President Susan Collins said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Xi Unlikely To Bring CEOs to Summit With Trump
top_signals.summary:
The highly anticipated summit between President Donald Trump and China’s Xi Jinping this week will bring together a robust group of US corporate leaders. But a comparable delegation of Chinese executives is not expected.

Stephen Engle explains what the uneven guest list could mean. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ethiopian Airlines Cancels Tigray Flights as Rebels Take Airport
top_signals.summary: Ethiopian Airlines has suspended flights to three destinations in Tigray, after reports that forces affiliated to the Tigray People’s Liberation Front had taken control of the airport in the regional capital.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
